        noncomputable def ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.corrWordPointedHeadActionOnUvoTargetClean {X H : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [(x : X) → Fintype (HeadIsnt x)] (E0 : X → PointedCorrEnd H) (D0 : CorrTensorTailEndData (vacuumFiber H)) (D : (x : X) → (M : CorrWordBimod H) → FuseWordBoundaryData (E0 x).corr M) (x : X) (a : End H) :
        End (CorrWordPointedUvoTarget E0 D0 D x)

        Clean replacement for corrWordPointedHeadActionOnUvoTarget. It does not use the discarded full-tensor-to-subspace bridge. On the committed vacuum coordinate it is exactly corrTensorMapLeft ... a after converting the unit-correspondence coordinate back to the pointed tail and then inserting the pointed vacuum tensor. The output vacuum coordinate is definitionally zero.
